quotes.author: Ryan Milavickas
quotes.text: It was a tough day for the bite but Captain Tim didn’t give up. Limited out on Reds!!!

Tim Stout is pure class, even when the fishing gods aren't smiling. Got completely blanked today but Tim's personality made it worthwhile. This guy's got stories for days and keeps you laughing between casts. Real down-to-earth captain who doesn't put on airs - just genuine passion for fishing and sharing it with others. He was more frustrated than we were about the slow bite, which tells you everything about his dedication. Tim's the kind of guide who becomes a buddy by the end of the trip. Zero fish but gained a solid fishing contact for future adventures.
